repos_data.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.
🎯 All you need. Nothing you don't. Open source project management that works for you, not against you.

AI-native, free, open-source alternative to Jira, Trello, ClickUp & Monday. Built for Scrum teams where humans and AI agents collaborate as equals — on the same board, the same sprints, the same goals. Self-hosted. Fully customizable via config and plugins.

Your agent loses the plan between sessions, so saga-mcp gives it a SQLite-backed tracker for projects, epics, tasks, subtasks, dependencies, and notes: 41 MCP tools, an activity log, and a one-call dashboard, with no accounts and no external services.
